claims.value: Dayhoff is a protein language model with a hybrid state-space Mamba and Transformer architecture, interleaved with Mixture-of-Experts modules. It is trained to predict mutation effects and generate novel protein sequences.
claims.evidence: The Dayhoff architecture is a hybrid of state-space Mamba layers and Transformer self-attention, interleaved with Mixture-of-Experts modules
This model should not be used to generate anything that is not a protein sequence or a set of homologuous protein sequences.
